groups.title: 5. Monitor, explain and complete the work

lessons.title: Check the training setup before creating a campaign
lessons.description: Check the training environment, available campaign routes and people who will perform the work.

lessons.title: Prepare fresh CSV sources and prove the review data
lessons.description: Prepare fresh people and reporting data, then verify account links, managers and reviewer sign-ins.

lessons.title: Complete a manager review and check the CSV result
lessons.description: Prepare a manager review, record justified choices, follow the manual work and check the CSV result.

lessons.title: Review a source and separate the owner's access
lessons.description: Review one source and inspect the independent review of its owner's own access.

lessons.title: Target people and access through Search
lessons.description: Select the requested people and source-specific permissions, then check the generated scope.

lessons.title: Compare campaign filters and review units
lessons.description: Compare inclusion, exclusion and packaged review units without starting the previews.

lessons.title: Reuse a template and prepare the next review cycle
lessons.description: Reuse a saved configuration and inspect what a later scheduled preparation produces.

lessons.title: Investigate missing and unexpected review items
lessons.description: Trace missing and unexpected review items, then repair the selections.

lessons.title: Transfer review work and handle reviewer absence
lessons.description: Hand over existing review work and arrange temporary cover for an absence.

lessons.title: Make clear decisions and finalize the review
lessons.description: Save, explain and revise unsigned choices before final submission.

lessons.title: Verify automated removal and recover a write failure
lessons.description: Verify a real connector removal, investigate a write failure and prove recovery.

lessons.title: Complete manual removal and verify each result
lessons.description: Complete removals in stages across two sources and check the full task scope.

lessons.title: Investigate access that remains after revocation
lessons.description: Investigate required access that remains after a revocation.

lessons.title: Monitor campaign progress and handle unfinished work
lessons.description: Separate draft choices, sign-off and removal progress, then handle unfinished work.

lessons.title: Build an evidence trail someone else can verify
lessons.description: Connect scope, decisions, work and account observations into a traceable case.

lessons.title: Correct or retire a campaign without losing the truth
lessons.description: Correct an unstarted campaign and handle a later changed need while retaining history.

lessons.title: Complete and defend an independent certification project
lessons.description: Plan and complete an independent review project with a change in responsibility and work needs.

lessons.title: Review uncorrelated account access and track ownership
lessons.description: Review an unmatched account's permissions and keep ownership follow-up explicit.

lessons.title: Review service-account access and preserve the service
lessons.description: Establish the program account's classification and owner, then review its access.

lessons.title: Review a role's contents and verify the correction
lessons.description: Review a role's design and verify the exact change to its contents.

lessons.title: Use activity and recommendations to support a review
lessons.description: Interpret available activity and recommendations alongside confirmed work requirements.

lessons.title: Investigate a certification through read-only APIs
lessons.description: Trace an existing review through complete read-only API requests.

lessons.title: Automate a bounded read-only evidence collection
lessons.description: Repeat verified evidence collection with a bounded read-only collector.
